5. Short term adverse impact on individuals because of economic loss due to curtailment of markets as a result of added restriction on United States imports.
6. Adverse impacts on individuals because restored species may compete with man for resources and space. For example, depredations by recovering endangered animals may have to be accepted.
7. Adverse impacts on Federal agencies because of added cost of decisions favoring endangered animals that may be affected by programs of that agency. Under the proposed legislation, all Federal agencies are directed to consider purposes of this Act in their day-to-day program decisions and some may need to adjust operating patterns where endangered species are concerned.
